title: Kosmesis registry index
description: Top-level shape of registry.<styleSystem>.json — the source list `packages/registry/scripts/build-registry.mjs` reads to produce the per-component JSON files served at `/r/<styleSystem>/<name>.json`.

path.description: Source path relative to packages/registry, e.g. "ui/tailwind/button.tsx".

target.description: Filename to write inside the consumer's ui alias directory. Defaults to the basename of `path`.

hash.description: SHA-256 of the file's content (line endings normalized to LF), written by the registry build into served items and index.json. Never written by hand.

version.description: Semver version of this item. Bump it whenever the item's files or dependencies change: `kosmesis outdated` compares it with the version a project installed, and the registry build fails when content changed but the version didn't (see registry-lock.json). Optional for third-party registries: an item without one is served as unversioned, which projects see as "unknown" and never as outdated.

dependencies.description: npm packages this component imports at runtime. Every package a component imports must be listed here (or, if all its imports are type-only, in devDependencies), except the ones every PraxisJS app already has: @praxisjs/core, @praxisjs/decorators, @praxisjs/jsx and @praxisjs/runtime. The registry build fails on an undeclared import.

devDependencies.description: npm packages only needed at build/type-check time (e.g. @types/..., or a package imported only with `import type`), installed with -D.

registryDependencies.description: Other registry item names this component's source imports from. A relative import (./button) must point at a file of the item itself or of one of these.
